sources.title: Claude AI can review pull requests and ship fixes on its own now

cards.summary: As part of a new Claude Ship product being announced today, Claude now can review, fix, and approve pull requests. Engineers have already been able to take advantage of Claude's code review capabilities thanks to the Code Review feature, which was announced in March and became generally available in October .

cards.summary: | Photo: Getty Images The clean energy revolution hinges on electrifying the entire global economy just as power-hungry data centers are surging. sources.title: How Jensen Huang ended up as Nvidia CEO again

cards.summary: The Jensen Huang era of Nvidia nearly came to an end this month. Huang, who three decades ago cofounded what's come to be considered one of the most important companies in AI, resigned from his role on November 12th over mounting scrutiny around his alleged affairs.

sources.title: Nothing’s upcoming Ear Note is a pair of earbuds with AI transcription

cards.summary: Nothing's new AI device is the Ear Note, a set of earbuds and their microphone-equipped charging case that can record and transcribe conversations, with a connected app to manage the recordings, transcriptions and AI-generated summaries, similar to Apple's new Watch feature and devices like Amazon's Bee wearable . Nothing CEO Carl Pei demonstrated the new device to Bloomberg , but said the company hasn't yet settled on a price ahead of a planned launch on December 8th.
